concept: Wondering about the world is fun, not something to be embarrassed about
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices something odd in the everyday world and can't stop wondering about it until they explore it
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's something strange or interesting you've noticed lately?
exercise.practice: Student picks one everyday thing and lists three wonders about it

assessment.success_marker: student generates at least two genuine wonders of their own
